content.description: A booking is confirmed only upon receipt of a signed agreement and a non-refundable deposit as specified in your proposal. The deposit secures your event date and covers initial planning and coordination services.

content.description: Payment schedules will be detailed in your service agreement. All payments must be made by the due dates specified.
